items.title: Coins
items.description: Earned by clearing waves in runs. Spend it in the shop to unlock weapons and traps.

items.title: Robux
items.description: Premium currency, paid for with real Robux in the Robux Shop.

items.title: Wisps
items.description: Run currency. Dropped by enemies. Spend it on weapon upgrades and placing traps. Resets every run.

items.title: Slingshot
items.description: A cheap ranged weapon. Slow, but reliable.

items.title: Bow
items.description: Long range and high damage per shot.

items.title: Shotgun
items.description: Close range burst: many pellets per shot, weaker the farther the target.

items.title: Snare
items.description: Floor trap. Holds an enemy in place and damages it.

items.title: Energy Wall
items.description: Wall trap. Damages enemies that cross the barrier.

items.title: Turret
items.description: Floor trap. Automatically shoots enemies in range.
